parsed.note_claim: The video shows US Air Force C-17 Globemaster IIIs airdropping aid, not Chinese planes.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Investigations into the footage reveal that most of the clips circulating online actually show a United States aid airdrop over Beit Lahiya, northern Gaza, from March 2024.
parsed.reason: The article explicitly identifies the footage as a US C-17 airdrop and states China does not operate this aircraft.
